# Live API Hub

> A verified directory of free public APIs, mobile agents, agent skills, and free LLM gateways — 260 entries across 36 categories, all link-checked live and tagged by free tier (178 fully free, 65 freemium, 17 paid). Built for phone-first builders: every entry works from a phone (Termux/Android) or a browser, with no PC needed.

## Directory

- [Live API Hub](https://dmdot714-cmd.github.io/Live-api-hub/): Searchable directory — search and filter by category, auth, pricing, and HTTPS.
- [Full data (JSON)](https://dmdot714-cmd.github.io/Live-api-hub/data/apis.json): The whole directory as one JSON file — 260 entries with name, category, tier, auth, docs URL, free-tier notes, and last-checked date.
- [Full listing (Markdown)](https://dmdot714-cmd.github.io/Live-api-hub/llms-full.txt): Every entry in readable Markdown, grouped by category.

## Project

- [GitHub repo](https://github.com/dmdot714-cmd/Live-api-hub): Source code, data, and automation.
- [README](https://github.com/dmdot714-cmd/Live-api-hub#readme): Project overview, data schema, and how to contribute.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/dmdot714-cmd/Live-api-hub/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Rules for adding or fixing an entry.

## Optional

- [Full listing (Markdown)](https://dmdot714-cmd.github.io/Live-api-hub/llms-full.txt): The complete directory — fetch this when you need every entry, not just the index.
